data_fields.name: zone_song_bed_event
data_fields.donor_constant: SoundEnv index per level selects Song, DayAmbience, DayEvent, EventDelay

data_fields.name: envelope_step_interval
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.2 s timer (donor steps envelopes at this cadence)

data_fields.name: max_voices
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (no voice cap; registry unbounded)

data_fields.name: voice_priority
data_fields.donor_constant: record Priority loaded but not read

best_idea: each zone names one song, one looping bed and one timed one-shot event; a zone change fades the old bed out while the new one fades in, and the overlap is the crossfade
decision_why: Keep the zone bundle and the fade overlap, but step envelopes every frame, add a voice cap that uses the priority field, and drive zone change from the server-confirmed transition instead of a 1-second poll.
acceptance: walking from a forest zone into a crypt zone, the forest bed fades out over its fade-out time while the crypt bed fades in, both audible in the overlap, no hard cut; a client test asserts the gain changes every frame and that no more than maxVoices beds are audible at once.
